text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INC#2026 triggered — spike in 502/gateway errors for route /v1/generate (upstream=EdgeNet, region=us-west-2). Alert rule: error_rate > 2% over 1m. Current 3.4% (3m). Pager routed to eng-oncall.

maya: taking pager — seeing 502s and elevated p50/p95. Any deploys recently? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: no deploys in last 30m. rollout/124 status: healthy.

jon: seeing 502 spike from upstream tag=EdgeNet starting ~2901234500. Affects model-service write path (POST /v1/generate).

sasha: impact check: dedicated-customer requests show ~12% failures for write-heavy routes in that window. Reads are fine.

maya: can we flip traffic to BACKUP_EDGE in us-west-2 for /v1/generate? If yes, do it and report. Paging platform on-call.

lee: on it. applying routing override: svc-router -> upstream_override=backup-edge for route /v1/generate. pushing now.

lee: done — override active. monitoring metrics.

jon: metrics update: error_rate fell from 3.6% -> 0.6% within ~90s of override. latency normalized.

maya: nice. I'm going to run the incident checklist. After mitigation, we should tune alerts so we detect upstream provider regressions earlier and reduce noisy pages.

jon: proposed alerting changes (initial thoughts):
- make 5xx error-rate alerts per-route (group by route/service) not global
- thresholds: critical if rate > 1.5% over 5m for production routes; warning at 0.5% over 5m
- suppress alerts during active deploys (deploy flag on metrics) and during planned maintenance windows
- add upstream-delta detector: compare error rate tagged by upstream provider vs cluster baseline to spot provider-specific degradation

Sample Prometheus rules to add:```\n# per-route 5xx error rate (production)\n- alert: RouteHigh5xxRate\n  expr: sum by(route)(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",env="prod"}[5m])) / sum by(route)(rate(http_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m])) > 0.015\n  for: 5m\n  labels:\n    severity: critical\n  annotations:\n    summary: "High 5xx rate on {{ $labels.route }}"\n\n# upstream provider spike (delta)\n- alert: UpstreamProviderErrorSpike\n  expr: (sum by(provider)(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",env="prod"}[1m])) - avg_over_time(sum by(provider)(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",env="prod"}[5m]))[1m:1m])) > 50\n  for: 2m\n  labels:\n    severity: warning\n``` 

sasha: also add dashboards: per-provider failure heatmap, per-route 5xx waterfall, recent routing overrides, last 1h deploys overlay. Make panels easy to pivot by customer id.

maya: agreed. Who owns PRs for alert rule + dashboard + runbook edits?

jon: I will open an infr-alerts PR with the rules and a playbook snippet for fallback routing + pages to platform contact. Will include tests and a runbook link. ETA ~4h.

maya: followups: schedule 1h debrief with EdgeNet AM to review incident and ask about mitigations (rate limiting, regional failover). Capture SLO impact: rough estimate ~5k failed requests during spike, affecting 3 dedicated customers. Add blameless note to incident tracker.

deploy-bot: rollout 124 completed 20m ago.

jon: PR created: https://git.redwood/infr-alerts/pulls/88 — includes alert rule changes, grafana dashboard draft, and runbook snippet. Will tag reviewers.

maya: handing off to next oncall @jon — I'm offline after 22:00. Leave updates here if anything else pops up.

jon: ack, taking over. I'll coordinate EdgeNet contact and finalize PR.

sasha: I'll mock the dashboard panels and open a ticket to sync with account team for customers impacted.

maya: incident status: mitigated. Mitigation: routing override to backup-edge for /v1/generate. Followups assigned to jon (alerts/pr), sasha (dashboards/account sync). Closing pager. :white_check_mark:

jon: adding one more followup: add alert suppression rules to avoid paging on known transient spikes <2m while still surfacing sustained provider failures.

lee: noted — will add guardrails to the router toggle so overrides are auditable (who/why) and surfaced in dashboard.

maya: thanks everyone. Closing thread.
